source_arguments.name: Quantum.StabilizerGroup.ToricCodeN.toSymplectic_vertexStab_Z_eq
source_arguments.statement:
private lemma toSymplectic_vertexStab_Z_eq (L : ℕ) [Fact (2 ≤ L)]
    (p : Fin L × Fin L) (i : Fin (numQubits L)) :
    NQubitPauliOperator.toSymplectic (vertexStab L p.1 p.2).operators
        (Fin.natAdd (numQubits L) i) =
      Stabilizer.Lattice.toricVertexCutMap (L := L)
        (Stabilizer.Lattice.singleVtx p) (qubitToEdgeIdx L i)
source_arguments.source_statement:
private lemma toSymplectic_vertexStab_Z_eq (L : ℕ) [Fact (2 ≤ L)]
    (p : Fin L × Fin L) (i : Fin (numQubits L)) :
    NQubitPauliOperator.toSymplectic (vertexStab L p.1 p.2).operators
        (Fin.natAdd (numQubits L) i) =
      Stabilizer.Lattice.toricVertexCutMap (L := L)
        (Stabilizer.Lattice.singleVtx p) (qubitToEdgeIdx L i)
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  haveI : Fact (0 < L) := ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 2) Fact.out⟩
  rw [NQubitPauliOperator.toSymplectic_Z_part]
  rw [show vertexStab L p.1 p.2 = Stabilizer.Lattice.toricZOperatorOfChain L
        (Stabilizer.Lattice.toricVertexCutMap (L := L) (Stabilizer.Lattice.singleVtx p)) from
    (Stabilizer.Lattice.toricZOperatorOfChain_cutMap_singleVtx L p.1 p.2).symm]
  rw [Stabilizer.Lattice.toricZOperatorOfChain_op_at]
  set v := Stabilizer.Lattice.toricVertexCutMap (L := L)
    (Stabilizer.Lattice.singleVtx p) (qubitToEdgeIdx L i) with hv
  rcases zmod2_zero_or_one v with h0 | h1
  · -- v = 0: no edge index has chain value 1 at i; symplectic = 0.
    rw [if_neg ?_]
    · rw [h0]; rfl
    · rintro ⟨e', heq, hone⟩
      -- e' = qubitToEdgeIdx L i (by injectivity), so v = chain at e' = 1 ≠ 0
      have h_inj : e' = qubitToEdgeIdx L i := by
        apply (edgeToQubitIdx_bijective L).1
        rw [heq, edgeToQubitIdx_qubitToEdgeIdx]
      rw [← h_inj] at hv
      rw [hv] at h0
      exact absurd hone (h0 ▸ (by decide : (0 : ZMod 2) ≠ 1))
  · -- v = 1: edge `qubitToEdgeIdx L i` has chain value 1; symplectic = 1.
    rw [if_pos ?_]
    · rw [h1]; rfl
    · refine ⟨qubitToEdgeIdx L i, edgeToQubitIdx_qubitToEdgeIdx L i, ?_⟩
      rw [← hv]; exact h1

/-- The X-half symplectic value of `faceStab L x y` at qubit `i` equals
`boundary2(singleFace (x,y))` evaluated at the edge corresponding to `i`. -/

method.description: Proof shows equality by case analysis on the value of a vertex cut map in ZMod 2

evidence: rw [show vertexStab L p.1 p.2 = Stabilizer.Lattice.toricZOperatorOfChain L
rcases zmod2_zero_or_one v with h0 | h1
have h_inj : e' = qubitToEdgeIdx L i := by
· -- v = 1: edge `qubitToEdgeIdx L i` has chain value 1; symplectic = 1.
· refine ⟨qubitToEdgeIdx L i, edgeToQubitIdx_qubitToEdgeIdx L i, ?_⟩

by

  refine S.induction_on ?_ ?_
  · rw [subsetProd_empty, Finset.sum_empty]

    rw [subsetProd_insert L hC hi, Finset.sum_insert hi]

source_arguments.statement:
theorem commutes_iff_symplectic_inner_zero (p q : NQubitPauliGroupElement n) :
    p * q = q * p ↔ symplecticInner p.operators q.operators = 0
source_arguments.source_statement:
theorem commutes_iff_symplectic_inner_zero (p q : NQubitPauliGroupElement n) :
    p * q = q * p ↔ symplecticInner p.operators q.operators = 0
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  rw [NQubitPauliGroupElement.commutes_iff_even_anticommutes]
  unfold NQubitPauliOperator.symplecticInner;
  have h_symplecticProductSingle : ∀ P Q : PauliOperator,
  PauliOperator.symplecticProductSingle P Q =
  if (P.mulOp Q).phasePower = (Q.mulOp P).phasePower + 2 then 1 else 0 := by
    rintro ( P | P | P | P ) ( Q | Q | Q | Q ) <;> simp +decide;
  rw [ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => h_symplecticProductSingle _ _ ]
  rw [Finset.sum_boole, ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff_even]
  congr! 2
  ext; simp [Quantum.NQubitPauliGroupElement.anticommutesAt]

/-- Two n-qubit Pauli group elements anticommute iff their symplectic inner product
  (on the operator parts) is 1. -/

source_arguments.statement:
private theorem radial_current_chart (r y : ℂ)
    (T R U V : Fin 2 → ℂ) (dT dR dU dV : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → ℂ)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hf : r^2-1 ≠ 0) :
    r^2/y^2 * actionSymplectic (RHTower.D4BMBackground.jet r y)
      (mixedJet T R dT dR) (mixedJet U V dU dV) 1 =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, (T a*(dV 0 a-dU 1 a)-U a*(dR 0 a-dT 1 a))
source_arguments.source_statement:
private theorem radial_current_chart (r y : ℂ)
    (T R U V : Fin 2 → ℂ) (dT dR dU dV : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → ℂ)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) (hf : r^2-1 ≠ 0) :
    r^2/y^2 * actionSymplectic (RHTower.D4BMBackground.jet r y)
      (mixedJet T R dT dR) (mixedJet U V dU dV) 1 =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, (T a*(dV 0 a-dU 1 a)-U a*(dR 0 a-dT 1 a))
source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  have hdet : (RHTower.D4BMBackground.jet r y).metric.det ≠ 0 := by
    change (RHTower.D4BMBackground.metric r y).det ≠ 0
    rw [RHTower.D4BMBackground.metric_det r y hf]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hr) (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hy)))
  rw [actionSymplectic_eq _ _ _ hdet]
  simp only [weightedInverse, connection, inverse, bg_first,
    show (RHTower.D4BMBackground.jet r y).metric = RHTower.D4BMBackground.metric r y from rfl,
    RHTower.D4BMBackground.metric_inverse r y hr hy hf]
  simp [mixedJet, mixedMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.trace, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  field_simp [hr,hy,hf]
  ring

/-- Exact Einstein radial symplectic density on the original exterior geometry.
All derivatives of the action current and its volume weight are differentiated;
all mixed metric first jets are free. No field equation or cancellation is assumed. -/
